mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kodik_episode_variant WHERE content_id = #{contentId} ORDER BY season_number, episode_number, translation_id

SELECT v.* FROM kodik_episode_variant v LEFT JOIN episode_source es ON es.content_id = v.content_id AND es.season = v.season_number AND es.episode = v.episode_number AND es.translator_id = CAST(v.translation_id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND es.provider = 'KODIK' LEFT JOIN episode_video ev ON ev.source_id = es.id AND ev.video_url IS NOT NULL WHERE v.content_id = #{contentId} AND ev.id IS NULL ORDER BY v.season_number, v.episode_number
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kodik_episode_variant (content_id, season_number, episode_number, translation_id, translation_title, translation_type, quality, kodik_link) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{seasonNumber}, #{episodeNumber}, #{translationId}, #{translationTitle}, #{translationType}, #{quality}, #{kodikLink})

INSERT INTO kodik_episode_variant (content_id, season_number, episode_number, translation_id, translation_title, translation_type, quality, kodik_link) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{seasonNumber}, #{episodeNumber}, #{translationId}, #{translationTitle}, #{translationType}, #{quality}, #{kodikLink}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE translation_title = VALUES(translation_title), translation_type = VALUES(translation_type), quality = VALUES(quality), kodik_link = VALUES(kodik_link)

insert.foreach: INSERT INTO kodik_episode_variant (content_id, season_number, episode_number, translation_id, translation_title, translation_type, quality, kodik_link) VALUES (#{v.contentId}, #{v.seasonNumber}, #{v.episodeNumber}, #{v.translationId}, #{v.translationTitle}, #{v.translationType}, #{v.quality}, #{v.kodikLink}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE translation_title = VALUES(translation_title), translation_type = VALUES(translation_type), quality = VALUES(quality), kodik_link = VALUES(kodik_link)

mapper.select: SELECT v.*, ev.video_url AS mp4_link, ev.decoded_at AS mp4_link_decoded_at, ev.decode_method AS decode_method FROM kodik_episode_variant v INNER JOIN episode_source es ON es.content_id = v.content_id AND es.season = v.season_number AND es.episode = v.episode_number AND es.translator_id = CAST(v.translation_id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND es.provider = 'KODIK' INNER JOIN episode_video ev ON ev.source_id = es.id AND ev.video_url IS NOT NULL WHERE v.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT v.*, ev.video_url AS mp4_link, ev.decoded_at AS mp4_link_decoded_at, ev.decode_method AS decode_method FROM kodik_episode_variant v INNER JOIN episode_source es ON es.content_id = v.content_id AND es.season = v.season_number AND es.episode = v.episode_number AND es.translator_id = CAST(v.translation_id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND es.provider = 'KODIK' INNER JOIN episode_video ev ON ev.source_id = es.id AND ev.video_url IS NOT NULL WHERE v.content_id = #{contentId} ORDER BY v.season_number, v.episode_number, v.translation_id

SELECT v.* FROM kodik_episode_variant v INNER JOIN episode_source es ON es.content_id = v.content_id AND es.season = v.season_number AND es.episode = v.episode_number AND es.translator_id = CAST(v.translation_id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND es.provider = 'KODIK' INNER JOIN episode_video ev ON ev.source_id = es.id AND ev.video_url IS NOT NULL AND ev.decoded_at IS NOT NULL AND ev.decoded_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hoursThreshold} HOUR) ORDER BY ev.decoded_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.* FROM kodik_episode_variant v LEFT JOIN episode_source es ON es.content_id = v.content_id AND es.season = v.season_number AND es.episode = v.episode_number AND es.translator_id = CAST(v.translation_id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND es.provider = 'KODIK' LEFT JOIN episode_video ev ON ev.source_id = es.id AND ev.video_url IS NOT NULL WHERE v.kodik_link IS NOT NULL AND ev.id IS NULL ORDER BY v.updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM kodik_episode_variant WHERE local_filepath IS NOT NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
